meta.title: xyflow mechanical inventory for @sentropic/graph parity
meta.guard: tools/re-xyflow/verify.mjs (independent syntactic AST extractor; see SPEC §2)
meta.countingConvention: One entry per mechanically enumerated observable: transitive public export (semantic module exports), flow-prop member, sub-component prop member, hook, instance method, store field/action, change variant, model field, enum member, edge path function/type, anchored interaction behaviour, example scenario. Duplicated React/Svelte names count once per package surface (family prefix distinguishes them). Generic DOM attribute expansions (HTMLAttributes/SVGAttributes) are excluded: only members declared inside the xyflow tree count.
